description: This file defines the `CodeValue` entity class used in the Fineract project. It models a code value with attributes like label, description, position, activation status, and mandatory flag. It provides methods for creation, JSON deserialization, updating from commands, and data transfer object conversion.

classes.name: CodeValue
classes.description: Entity class representing a code value with attributes and methods for creation, updating, and data transformation.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new `CodeValue` instance with specified properties.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a `CodeValue` object from a JSON command, extracting relevant parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the `CodeValue` properties based on a JSON command, tracking changes.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the `CodeValue` entity to a data transfer object for external use.
